reason: Bile and lipase are shown acting on dietary fat droplets.
expectation: The fat will be prepared and broken down into smaller components for absorption.

effect: Fat digestion produced fatty acids and monoglycerides, completing the chapter; the explanation distinguishes bile's dispersal role from lipase's enzymatic action.
reaction: That distinction was useful, though monoglycerides were not explained.

mostWorthwhile.text: Breaking starch down in two stages was worthwhile: the planned pictures trace chains becoming individual glucose molecules, connecting digestion to absorption.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the three named organ slots was clear but repetitive, with little decision-making beyond matching names.

surprise.text: The final explanation clarified that bile disperses fat rather than acting as an enzyme; lipase performs the breakdown.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the portal vessel slot remained unfilled when the chapter ended and its later connection was not explained here.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the digestion products cross the gut lining and where the portal vessel fits; this chapter prepares for absorption but stops before showing it.
